engineering_notes.1: Forever lists Shadowfiend in the Shadow Magic skill line from level 1 (SkillLineAbility row 49886, spell 401977).
engineering_notes.3: Rank 6 (19280) is spellconst's top rank and the highest the engine registers at level 60.
engineering_notes.6: sim/priest/shadow_word_death.go: Forever's tier 5 Early Demise talent gives it bonus crit chance below 20% target health, read through the engine's execute-phase approximation (isExecutePhase E20). The cast itself is on cooldown, not held for the execute phase.

notes: Rotation-accuracy program, wand-weaving addition (2026-09-28): Shoot (5019) is declared inert because this build's item table (data/builds/<active>/items/priest.json filtered to simitems.json's known ids) has no wand with required_level <= 10, so the ladder's level-10 rung equips nothing in the ranged slot and core.RegisterShootSpell never registers the spell there; from level 20 on, once a wand is available, it resolves and fires heavily (the level 20-60 rungs below show it as up to 82 percent of top casts on this bare, no-consumes, no-buffs ladder character). Adapted from the fork's shadow_priest/apls/p1.apl.json. Devouring Plague's off-by-one registration bug (an old 'Fix round 1' that had temporarily moved this file's authored id back to rank 5) and the follow-up 'rank 5 casts instead of rank 6' diagnosis are both stale and superseded (audit-priest, 2026-09-28): sim/priest/devouring_plague.go's registration loop runs the full 1..DevouringPlagueRanks range, this file's strictSequence has authored rank 6 (19280) since before this audit, and a direct 3000-iteration reproduction of the level-60 bare-gear ladder request (forever-sim, engine b5ac36a52) casts 19280 and never 19279. Shadow Word: Death (1309636, sim/priest/shadow_word_death.go) is implemented and does deal damage under isExecutePhase(E20) -- the same reproduction cast it 408 times over 3000 iterations (avg 0.136/iteration) -- it is simply rare on the ladder's bare, no-mana-regen gear: it is priced at 340 mana, sits behind Shadow Word: Pain's upkeep in priority, and only has a window when BOTH the execute phase is open AND mana remains, so a specific 300-iteration seed landing on zero casts (this ladder's golden) is not surprising and is not the engine-primitive bug the previous note attributed it to (see expected_idle below; that comparison to paladin-retribution's Hammer of Wrath and warrior-fury's Execute conflated a real resource-scarcity effect with the shared isExecutePhase primitive, which this reproduction shows working correctly for Shadow Word: Death). Engine numbers (audit-priest, 2026-09-28): Shadow Word: Pain's and Devouring Plague's BonusCoefficient were hardcoded to vanilla-Classic-shaped values (an escalating table topping out at 0.167, and 0.063) that this build's own spellconst carries no support for; spellconst's sp_coefficient is a flat 0.2 for every Shadow Word: Pain rank and a flat 0.1 for every Devouring Plague rank, fixed on fork branch audit-priest (unpushed; needs a real engine-pin bump once merged). Shadowform is still cast at prepull, Shadow Word: Pain is maintained with the same fight-end guard as the source preset, and Inner Focus into Devouring Plague, Mind Blast on cooldown, and Mind Flay as filler are otherwise unchanged. Every rank named here is checked against the spellconst of the newest client build in builds/. Theorycraft audit fix (design/reviews/2026-10-31-theorycraft-audit/casters.md P1, P2, P3): Mind Blast moved above Mind Flay, Devouring Plague is kept up on its 24-second cooldown instead of only behind Inner Focus, Inner Focus now feeds Mind Blast, and the duplicate execute Mind Blast line went away. The engine now applies Shadowform's half cost and crit bonus to Mind Blast. About +12 percent in that run. Round-2 audit (design/reviews/2026-11-01-sim-audit-round2/casters.md): Shadow Word: Death is cast on cooldown rather than only below 20% health, the order Warcraft Tavern and wowtbc give. Shadowfiend (401977) is cast below 30% mana (the healing lists use half); its pet's own damage is not modeled.

expected_idle.reason: Inner Focus shares a strictSequence with Mind Blast. It is a Discipline talent the guide build only reaches near level 60, so the truncated leveling builds on the lower rungs do not have it and the sequence never starts there; at level 60 it casts whenever it is ready.

priorityList.notes: Shadowfiend below 30% mana: the fiend returns 5% of your maximum mana with each attack for 15 seconds, on a five-minute cooldown.
Shadow Word: Pain is kept up unless the fight is about to end, when refreshing it would waste most of the DoT.
Devouring Plague is kept up: its 24-second cooldown lets it be reapplied when it expires, and its ticks crit.
Inner Focus into Mind Blast: a free Mind Blast with extra crit chance whenever Inner Focus is ready.
Mind Blast on cooldown ahead of Mind Flay: it is the bigger hit per cast time, and Shadowform halves its cost and doubles its crit bonus.
Shadow Word: Death on cooldown ahead of Mind Flay, as both Forever guides order it; below 20% target health Early Demise adds crit chance.
Mind Flay fills every remaining global.
Shoot only when nothing else can be cast: a wand shot cannot start during the global cooldown and holds you for the wand's full speed, so it never fits between spells.
